No front door for ads

Nothing ads can send cold traffic to

A woman who has never heard of you won’t apply for 1:1 from one ad. There’s no free event that turns a stranger into someone who trusts how you think.

No qualifying step

Calls do the sorting

Connection and momentum calls bring in everyone, whether they’re ready for 1:1 or just curious. Each one takes an hour of your week to find out.

Tied to posting

998 posts keep the applications coming

When you post less, fewer people reach your links page. Lead flow rises and falls with your energy, not with a system.

The women who love your content but aren’t ready for 1:1 today drift off, and you can’t tell which of them will be ready next month.

A free live masterclass between your content and your 1:1 coaching
